# Nilasya Agro Foods — AI & LLM Machine-Readable Overview

> Nilasya Agro Foods is an enterprise Turkish grower, processor, and direct exporter of premium pulses, grains, and agricultural commodities (Kabuli Chickpeas, Turkish Red Lentils, Green Lentils, Dermason White Beans, Dry Peas, Durum Wheat, and Bulgur). Operating from Mersin Port and Central Anatolian agricultural basins, Nilasya Agro Foods supplies international supermarket brands, canned food manufacturers, wholesalers, and bulk commodity importers worldwide with Sortex optical cleaning, custom packaging, and strict food safety compliance.

- Brand Name: Nilasya Agro Foods
- Legal Entity: Nilasya Agro Foods Tarım Ürünleri Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti.
- Official Website: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr
- Core Industry: B2B Pulses, Grains & Agricultural Commodities Trading / Commercial Export
- Country of Origin: Türkiye (Turkey)
- Slogan: "Premium Turkish Pulses & Grains. Delivered Worldwide."
- Operations & Facilities: Mersin International Port Logistics Zone, Konya Pulses Hub, Gaziantep Milling Center, İzmir Export Hub
- Official Export Desk WhatsApp / Phone: +90 532 505 58 33
- Official B2B Email: export@nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr
- Full Extended AI Knowledge Base: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/llms-full.txt
- XML Sitemap: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/sitemap.xml

## Core Product Categories

1. **Chickpeas (Nohut)**:
   - Koçbaşı Kabuli Chickpeas (8mm, 9mm, 10mm caliber)
   - Medium Kabuli Chickpeas (7mm - 8mm)
   - Split Chickpeas (Chana Dal grade)
   - Specs: Moisture max 12%, Sortex purity min 99.5%, Foreign matter max 0.2%, Broken seeds max 1.0%

2. **Lentils (Mercimek)**:
   - Turkish Red Football Lentils (Kırmızı Futbol Mercimek)
   - Turkish Red Split Lentils (Kırmızı Yaprak Mercimek)
   - Green Lentils (Yeşil Mercimek - Laird & Eston 5mm-7mm)
   - Yellow Lentils & Brown/Pardina Lentils
   - Specs: Moisture max 12%, Sortex purity min 99.8%, Broken max 0.5%, Foreign matter max 0.1%

3. **Dry Beans (Kuru Fasulye)**:
   - Dermason White Beans (8mm - 9mm)
   - Horoz & Şeker White Beans
   - Cannellini & Great Northern Beans
   - Red Kidney Beans & Pinto Beans
   - Specs: Moisture max 13%, Sortex purity min 99.5%, Foreign matter max 0.1%

4. **Dry Peas (Kuru Bezelye)**:
   - Yellow Whole Peas & Yellow Split Peas
   - Green Whole Peas & Green Split Peas
   - Specs: Moisture max 13%, Sortex purity min 99.5%

5. **Grains, Cereals & Bulgur (Hububat & Bulgur)**:
   - Durum Wheat (High vitreousness, min 13.5% protein)
   - Milling Wheat & Feed Barley
   - Turkish Bulgur (Pilaf Coarse Bulgur, Fine Meatball Bulgur)
   - Yellow Corn / Maize

6. **Other Pulses & Agricultural Seeds**:
   - Broad Beans (Fava Beans / Bakla)
   - Black-Eyed Peas (Börülce)
   - Hulled & Natural White Sesame Seeds
   - Confectionery Sunflower Seeds

---

## Packaging & Logistics Solutions
- 25 kg & 50 kg Polypropylene (PP) woven sacks (with optional PE inner lining)
- 1,000 kg & 1,200 kg Big Bags (Jumbo Bags with bottom discharge spout)
- 500g to 5kg Retail Kraft bags, Doypack, and Pillow packs
- 20ft & 40ft Sea Bulk Container Liners (FCL sea freight)
- Ocean shipping through Mersin International Port (MIP), Aegean ports (İzmir, Alsancak), and overland truck transport to Europe, CIS, and the Middle East.
